Bill.BriefDescription: Waiving bar membership fees for legislative attorneys.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to bar association membership fees for legislativeattorneys; amending RCW 2.48.130 and 2.48.140 and adding a new sectionto chapter 2.48 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 2.48 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An active or inactive member of the bar is not required to pay theannual membership fee for active or inactive members during any periodof time that the member is employed as a fulltime employee by theWashington state senate, the Washington state house of representatives,or the statute law committee. The board of governors may not provide for any additionalqualifications, requirements, or procedures for legislative attorneyswho are covered by this section beyond those imposed on other active orinactive members, except that the board may provide by rule forprorating the annual membership fees for partial years of employmentwith the legislative agencies named in this section.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 2.48.130 and 1957 c 138 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The annual membership fees for active members shall be payable onor before February 1st of each year. Subject to section 1 of this act,the board of governors may establish the amount of such annualmembership fee to be effective each year: PROVIDED, That writtennotice of any proposed increase in membership fee shall be sent toactive members not less than sixty days prior to the effective date ofsuch increase: PROVIDED FURTHER, That the board of governors mayestablish the fee at a reduced rate for those who have been activemembers for less than five years in this state or elsewhere.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 2.48.140 and 1955 c 34 s 1 are each amended to read asfollows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Subject to section 1 of this act, the annual membership fee forinactive members shall be the sum of two dollars, payable on or beforethe first day of February of each year.
